_comment: EXAMPLE registry schema for genie-agent installations.
The real file lives at config/genie_env.json (gitignored: machine-specific
paths). Copy this file there and fill in absolute paths for your host.
per installation under config/env/<name>.json by scripts/refresh_genie_env.py;
runlogs additionally fingerprint the snapshot (inputs.env_sha256), the
binary (inputs.genie_bin_sha256) and the install git state
(inputs.genie_install_git), so a manifest row pins what these names meant.
